title: Ask @claude on GitHub
intro: The Claude GitHub Action is set up. Pick what you do.

inputs.label: You
options: Comment "@claude fix this bug" on an issue

when.equals: Comment "@claude fix this bug" on an issue

show.title: A fix arrives
show.detail: The workflow runs Claude Code, which implements the change and can open a pull request.

show.title: Use /install-github-app
show.detail: Run it in Claude Code to install the app and add the workflow and secret.

show.title: Nothing happens
show.detail: The trigger phrase, @claude by default, starts the workflow.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: What can the action use instead of an API key?
options: A subscription token from claude setup-token
quiz.explanation: Subscription plans can use CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, made with claude setup-token.
